Here are a handful of quick‑and‑snappy ideas that blend AI with the “side‑ hustle” vibe:

| # | Newsletter Title | Why it Works |
|---|------------------|--------------|
| 1 | **AI‑Side Hustle** | Direct, descriptive, and perfect for on‑the‑go readers. |
| 2 | **Side‑Brain** | A playful nod to “brain” (AI) + “side” hustle. |
| 3 | **Brainy Gig** | Highlights the smarts behind each side‑gig idea. |
| 4 | **The AI Hustle Hub** | Emphasizes community while keeping “hustle.” |
| 5 | **Side‑Gig GPT** | Ties in the popular GPT family name for instant relevance. |
| 6 | **Flagship Side‑Gigs** | “Flagship” implies top picks, great for a curated list. |
| 7 | **Automated Side‑Whiz** | Combines “automated” (AI) with “whiz” (skill). |
| 8 | **Gig‑Bot Guide** | Bot = AI, guide = helpful advice. |
| 9 | **Earn With AI** | Straight‑to‑the‑point, great if you want a hipster feel. |
|10 | **The AI Side‑Throttle** | “Throttle” suggests speed and extra effort. |

Pick the one that feels most natural to your brand voice and your target audience, or mix & match words from several to create a custom title!
